Title: ScribeCo records customer calls with no contract of any kind
What we found: AIS-01 joins internal and customer calls and stores audio and transcripts in the United States. There is no contract, DPA or transfer mechanism. CGI-TPR-001 set a decision for 15 Oct 2026; none is recorded.
Requirement: GDPR Arts 28 and 44-46; CGI-TPR-001 Gate B (no DPA, no onboarding); CGI-POL-001 s4.5.1-4.5.2
Root cause: Bought on a personal card; never entered onboarding; the decision date passed without an owner chasing it.
Remediation: Today: remove the bot from all calls. By 24 Oct: CEO decides contract (DPA, no training, no human review, transfer mechanism, 30-day retention, deletion on exit) or exit with a deletion certificate. Record a nonconformity against CGI-POL-001 s4.5.

Title: ChatCo's AI reads customer content under no training prohibition, and the switch-off is unevidenced
What we found: F-004 (15 Sep 2026): AI features process message content, including customers' posts in 3 shared channels; training not prohibited, human review not excluded. Action R4 (switch off by 01 Oct 2026) has no completion evidence.
Root cause: AI terms not read at procurement; R4 had no evidence requirement checked.
Remediation: Screenshot the admin setting showing AI off (today). Keep off until the DPA includes no-training and no-human-review clauses (ISO-09).

Title: The approved AI tools list the policy depends on does not exist
What we found: CGI-POL-001 s4.5.1 tells staff to use only tools on the CTO's approved list. No list is recorded anywhere, so staff cannot comply and nobody can check.
Root cause: The policy clause was approved before the list was built.
Remediation: Publish list v1 (WriteCo with conditions; ScribeCo and ChatCo AI pending) and adopt the AI register from Part 2 as its record.

Title: Cypher cannot yet prove it has no prohibited or high-risk AI use
What we found: VQ-67 answers are recorded for ChatCo only. AI features of HRCo, SupportCo, CRMCo, OfficeCo and the other suppliers are unconfirmed, so AI-A02 and AI-A03 are assumptions.
Requirement: AI Act Arts 5 and 6 with Annex III (classification needs a complete population)
Root cause: The AI questionnaire domain has been answered by one Tier 1 supplier.
Remediation: Run an AI-feature census: VQ-67 and VQ-68 to all 17 suppliers; confirm HRCo has no screening or evaluation features in use.

Title: AI literacy measures cover 60% of staff and say nothing specific about AI
What we found: CGI-POL-001 (with s4.5) is acknowledged by 60% of staff. No AI-use module exists (OFI-04). Some measure exists, so the Art. 4 duty is partly met, not unmet.
Requirement: AI Act Art. 4 (take measures to support AI literacy; since 2 Feb 2025, rewritten 27 Jul 2026)
Remediation: AI-use module for every staff member who uses AIS-01 to AIS-03, with a completion record; pulled forward from REC-09.

Title: No record that AI output is checked before it reaches a customer
What we found: CGI-POL-001 s4.5.3 requires a competent person to review AI output before it is sent to a customer. No review record or reviewer exists, and nobody has tested ScribeCo's accuracy.
Root cause: Rule written; no procedure or record behind it.
Remediation: Named reviewers per tool; review step and log; monthly sample of 10 summaries checked against recordings.

Title: No DPIA was done for three AI tools that meet the DPIA criteria
What we found: Screening against the nine EDPB criteria: ScribeCo meets 4, ChatCo AI 3, WriteCo 3. Two or more usually means a DPIA is required. None has one.
Remediation: DPIA for ScribeCo before any further use, and for ChatCo AI before re-enabling; WriteCo by 30 Nov. Add the trigger to CGI-TPR-001.

Title: No AI policy, AIMS scope or AI roles
What we found: The only AI rules are four clauses in CGI-POL-001 s4.5. Nobody owns AI governance.
Root cause: AI arrived through suppliers before anyone planned for it.
Remediation: AI policy v1.0 (extends s4.5; banned uses; impact-assessment rule), AIMS scope statement and AI roles in the ISO-04 RACI.

Title: People on recorded calls are not told
What we found: Customers and staff on ScribeCo calls, and customers in ChatCo shared channels, are not told their words are processed by a third-party AI.
Root cause: Tools arrived outside any process that writes notices.
Remediation: Spoken and written notice on every recorded call; channel notice; AI sub-processors added to the customer-facing list.

Title: No route to report a harmful or wrong AI output
What we found: CGI-POL-005 covers security incidents. Nothing tells staff or customers how to report a wrong summary or misuse of an AI tool.
Root cause: AI harms were never treated as incidents.
Remediation: Add an 'AI output or misuse' category to CGI-POL-005 reporting, and a customer contact route.

Title: Nothing stops an approved tool being used for a banned or high-risk purpose
What we found: Onboarding controls new tools, not new uses. HR could use WriteCo to rank applicants (Annex III 4(a), and Art. 25(1)(c) would make Cypher the provider) or switch on voice emotion analysis (Art. 5(1)(f)).
Requirement: AI Act Arts 5, 6(2) and Annex III, 25(1)(c); ISO/IEC 42001 A.9.4
Root cause: Use is assessed at purchase, never afterwards.
Remediation: Banned-use list in the AI policy; intended use recorded per tool in the register; HR sign-off for any AI touching staff decisions.

Title: AI suppliers are missing from what customers are told about Cypher's service
What we found: The draft system description and customer obligations (SOC-02) do not mention AI suppliers or AI features.
Root cause: Written before the AI inventory existed.
Remediation: Add AI suppliers and any AI-related customer obligations to SOC-02 and the trust page (SOC-13).

Title: Scenario AI-A01: no design gate for Cypher's first AI product feature
What we found: The planned project assistant would make Cypher a provider with Art. 50 duties at launch. No intended-purpose statement, design controls (A.6, A.7) or supplier assessment of ModelCo exists, and CGI-POL-007 (secure development) is not yet written.
Requirement: AI Act Arts 3(3), 50(1)-(2), 6(2) and Annex III 4(b); ISO/IEC 42001 A.6, A.7, A.5
Remediation: Design gate before any build: intended-purpose statement excluding staff evaluation; Art. 50 design requirements; impact assessment; ModelCo assessed as Tier 1 under CGI-TPR-001.
